1 Contract Manager (m/f/d) Job ID 520262

Siemens Mobility location in 1110 Vienna.
You will analyse, draft and evaluate customer and supplier contracts, identify relevant opportunities and risks during project management and advise the project teams competently on contract-related issues.

 * In addition, you will support the creation, negotiation and enforcement of amendments vis-à-vis customers and suppliers, ensuring the documentation and prosecution of claims as part of claim management.
 * You will analyze project deviations in terms of costs, deadlines and scope of services, carry out delay analyses and evaluate the causes and effects of schedule deviations.
 * In doing so, you will identify, document and assert downtime, obstructions and productivity losses and support the project teams in preparing evidence to enforce additional costs and compensation claims.
 * You will work closely with the areas of project management, commercial management, engineering, procurement and legal counsel and accompany negotiations as well as the out-of-court or judicial enforcement of claims.

Your qualifications - solid and relevant

 * You have successfully completed a university degree in law or an economic/technical university degree with basic legal training.
 * You have a special interest and in-depth knowledge of contract law and ideally have already gained 3-5 years of professional experience in contract management, claim management or project management in the context of complex infrastructure or rolling stock projects.
 * You have a pronounced willingness to familiarize yourself with the technical details of infrastructure projects in order to form an effective interface between law and technology.
 * You are very interested in using AI to increase the quality and efficiency of your work. 
 * Personally, you are characterized by a structured, analytical way of working, initiative, strong communication skills and enjoyment of interdisciplinary cooperation.
 * You are willing to travel nationally and internationally.
 * Since you work in an international project environment, you are fluent in both written and spoken German and English. Ideally, you also have excellent knowledge of Romanian or another Eastern European language.

What do we offer you?

 * Internationality - We offer an attractive working environment in an innovative, globally active group with diverse and responsible tasks in an international environment
 * Purpose - We are pioneers of mobility. With us, you are actively contributing to the transport turnaround and climate protection in a market of the future, because our transport solutions reduce CO2 emissions all over the world.
 * Reconciling family and career - With flexible working hours and the possibility of working from home, we help you to concentrate fully on your career without losing sight of the demands of your family life.
 * Attractive conditions - You will receive an attractive remuneration package within the framework of the Collective Agreement for the Electrical and Electronics Industry of Austria and other extras such as employee share programmes and company pension schemes.
 * Further development - We offer you comprehensive training opportunities for your professional and personal development, both online and offline.
 * Team - Become part of our highly committed and collaborative team.

What else do I need to know?We offer an attractive compensation package that reflects your qualifications and professional experience. The gross annual salary for this position, as defined by the applicable collective agreement, is at least EUR 65,041.34. Depending on your education and experience, a higher salary may be offered. As a large international corporation, Siemens also provides additional benefits and social perks.
How can I apply?If you are interested in this position, we look forward to receiving your detailed online application.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. As Head of Order Management (m/f/d) Medium Power Transformers, you lead the organization responsible for managing the factory's customer order portfolio within an Engineering-to-Order business. You ensure the successful execution of projects from order intake to delivery, meeting targets for schedule, cost, quality, and customer satisfaction. What You'll Do
 * Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for new digital products, aligned with client business goals and validated against real user needs
 * Take products from scratch - frame the problem, shape the proposition, and validate before scaling; create new propositions, not just improve existing ones
 * Lead product discovery with user research, analytics, benchmarking and hypothesis validation; size opportunities quantitatively
 * Prioritize the backlog by customer value, business impact and technical feasibility, using clear frameworks
 * Lead agile teams across engineering, UX/UI, data and QA, coordinating with marketing, sales and operations for launch
 * Define success metrics, track them, and run an evidence-based cycle of experimentation, learning and iteration
 * Use generative AI and agents to accelerate definition, validation and prototyping - AI as part of how you work
 * Contribute to commercial outcomes - help ship revenue-generating propositions and deliver against targets

Requirements
 * Hands-on experience across the full digital product lifecycle - discovery, definition, delivery and measurement
 * Exposure to 0-to-1 work: you've helped create and validate new products or features, not only maintained existing roadmaps
 * 3-5 years in product management / product ownership for digital products
 * Commercially minded - you've worked to clear targets and are keen to own a number
 * Data-literate: fluent with product analytics, A/B testing and funnel/CRO optimization; you use data as evidence
 * A clear writer - your documents move discussions forward and help teams decide
 * High agency and comfort with ambiguity: you set your own priorities and move without waiting for a perfect brief

 * A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
 * Experience in venture building, startups, or innovation consulting
 * Technical fluency to dialogue with engineering (APIs, web/mobile architectures)
 * Product marketing or positioning background
 * Solid command of agile methods (Scrum, Kanban) and prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, ...)

Benefits
The Numbers: €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: An experienced crew in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears - from designs to business ideas or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

Application process
We run a 3-stage process to understand who you are - and help you understand us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.

jobs.description:
1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications.
 * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation.
 * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems.
 * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further.
 * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications.
 * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous.
 * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial.
 * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
